title: Fall Commencement
seo_title: Fall Commencement at Great Southern Bank Arena, Dec 11
description: Missouri State University holds its Fall Commencement ceremonies to celebrate graduates, with a 10 am ceremony for the Darr College of Agriculture, College of Business, College of Natural and Applied Sciences, and Interdisciplinary Academic Programs, and a 1:30 pm ceremony for the McQueary College of Health and Human Services, Reynolds College of Arts, Social Sciences, and Humanities, and College of Education. No ticket is required and there is no limit on guests per graduate; doors open 90 minutes before each ceremony, all guests go through security, only clear bags are permitted, and the ceremonies will be livestreamed. It takes place Friday, December 11, 2026 at Great Southern Bank Arena, 901 S. National Ave., Springfield, MO.
